parameters.content:
## Google Trends Interest & Related Query Scraper

**Actor:** [Google Trends Interest & Related Query Scraper](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/google-trends-interest-and-related-query-scraper)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/google-trends-interest-and-related-query-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string)
- `searchTerms` (array)
- `compareMode` (boolean)
- `startUrls` (array)
- `geo` (string)
- `timeRange` (string)
- `customDateRange` (string)
- `category` (string)
- `searchType` (string)
- `geoResolution` (string)
- `trendingHours` (string)
- `trendingCategory` (string)

### Output fields
- `searchTerms` (Terms)
- `title` (Trending term)
- `geoName` (Location)
- `timeRangeLabel` (Time label)
- `hoursLabel` (Window)
- `categoryName` (Category)
- `searchTypeLabel` (Type label)
- `averageInterest` (Avg)
- `volumeText` (Volume)
- `growthPercent` (Growth %)
- `exploreUrl` (URL)
- `trendingUrl` (Trends URL)

description: Export Google Trends data: runs the Google Trends Interest & Related Query Scraper Apify Actor, returns searchTerms, title, geoName, averageInterest, growthPercent and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
